rawContent: To folks who say “you’ll want a cop when you’re in trouble” you’re right, I will & I will also expect to not be shot 20 times when they arrive. That’s the issue, they see my skin & assume I’m the criminal & not the victim. #BlackLivesMatter #TakeAKnee #ItsAPhone #ILiveHere

I am standing up & screaming “YES! YES! YES!!!!!” When is enough enough? This is why that #MeToo meant very little to me because Black girls & women are overlooked & marginalized. No one rallies for us. Can we shut him down like you did so many others? We are waiting... https://t.co/nj1la3Euh1
